approved_input_audit.mortality_definition: observed cumulative deaths on 2021-12-31 / observed cumulative cases 14 days earlier

beta.status: method ready; numerical beta conditional on valid Rt and selected rates
beta.available_basis: Rt_estimated can support beta only after gamma and mu are defensibly specified
beta.formula_relation: beta = Rt_estimated * (gamma + mu) for the stated SEIRD equations

sigma.required_parameter: incubation period or an equivalent exposed-to-infectious transition rate

mu.reason: Derived from Verity IFR 0.0066 and primary gamma using mu = gamma*p/(1-p); the OWID lagged CFR is not used.
